name: One-shot Euclidean Signed Distance Field (ESDF)
definition: Computes a Euclidean signed distance field from a Truncated Signed Distance Field (TSDF) grid using a one-shot cold-start approach, involving topology dilation, seeding, and a fixed-point monotone-min Jacobi sweep.
summary: One-shot ESDF computes a globally consistent Euclidean signed distance field from a TSDF grid via a cold-start Jacobi sweep, differing from incremental methods by always recomputing the entire field from scratch.
